title: Cardinal Caracciolo (Milan) to Charles V, 14 November 1537 (AGS Estado leg. 1184 fol. 110, DECODE R9966)

documents.route: Cardinal Marino Ascanio Caracciolo (Milan) to Charles V

plaintext.source: Tomokiyo, cryptiana spanish2C (first four lines only)

transcription.source: read directly from DECODE image P1 (AGS 0409) into reading.txt
transcription.notes: Deciphered line by line from the images without a separate sign transcription, so no token count; the writer's cancelling strokes cross lines 1-11.

system.summary: Luo's Cifrario 38: homophonic sign alphabet plus consonant base signs with superscript vowel digits (5-9 = a e i o u), nulls with superscripts 2-4, a few code words.
system.notes: Key applied unchanged from Luo 2021 p. 657.

prior_solution.where: Tomokiyo, cryptiana 'Spanish ciphers during the reign of Charles V' (Luo update): names Lu.38 and reads the first four lines

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login and passed its session cookie to the model, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Tomokiyo spanish2C copy grepped for R9966: readable with Luo's Lu.38; first four lines given.
DECODE R9966 record and 4 images fetched with the shared cookie; order mapped to AGS 0408-0411.
Luo 2021 thesis downloaded from RODERIC; Cifrario 38 table (p. 657) read.
Luo PDF searched for leg. 1184 and the names in the cipher: letter not edited.
11 cipher lines of AGS 0409 deciphered line by line with Cifrario 38 unchanged; Tomokiyo's lines confirmed with two corrections; lines 5-11 read with scattered gaps.
Retry: gap spots re-read at 4x with autocontrast; hooked 9 = e homophone (line 4), dotted # = null (line 5); others unchanged.

Second pass on every line at 4x: superscript belongs to the preceding sign, bare ♀ = r, barred g = f, dotted = null; lines 5-11 and the cancelled line read ('Elvetii', 'frumento', 'harriano', 'quante volte').

outcome.method_basis: Wanruo Luo's Cifrario 38 (2021 thesis), the key for the Charles V-Caracciolo correspondence, which Tomokiyo's cryptiana had already named for R9966 with its first four lines read, read the letter unchanged.
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.txt, plaintext letters of the 11 cipher lines + cancelled line: 453 read, 18 unread (each [..] counted as 2 letters, every word marked ? counted unread)
outcome.notes: Published key read the letter unchanged; Tomokiyo had read four lines; the rest read here, about 10 signs doubtful.
